mentions.name: SimpleeFood
mentions.description: A simple self-hosted recipe app for storing, searching, and viewing recipes, with a full-screen viewing mode for easy cooking on a tablet or phone.
mentions.problem: Most existing recipe app offerings are too bloated; recipes just need to be stored, searched, and viewed easily.
